headline: The selected clip now says what it is made of: VIDEO, AUDIO or STILL, in the same colours as Trace+
notes: **A coloured badge beside the clip name.** VIDEO, AUDIO or STILL, pinned to the right of the name. It is the same word and the same colour Trace+ uses, taken from the same shared engine, so a file badged VIDEO in one panel can never read AUDIO in the other. Nothing is badged for a sequence, a title, a colour matte or a path the panel could not read — silence beats a guess.

**Row badges kept their colour.** Adding the media kinds introduced a second copy of the badge colour map, which quietly overwrote the first: every REPEAT, OTHER and nest badge lost its tone while the new badge looked perfect. Caught by the panel tests before release, fixed to one map.
